stories.name: Meta AI Push
stories.blurb: Mark Zuckerberg is aggressively driving Meta's development of superintelligent AI, promising broad access while rejecting industry calls to slow down.

stories.name: Meta Stock Debate
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts weigh in on Meta Platforms' stock valuation and buying opportunities following Q2 2026 earnings, AI spending returns, and a recent price selloff.

stories.name: Meta Muse AI agent
stories.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI agent has sparked a sharp rally in Meta stock as investors and analysts bet it could become a major competitive threat to Google and a landmark AI product.

stories.name: Meta Child Addiction Lawsuits
stories.blurb: State and individual lawsuits accuse Meta of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive to children, leading to court rulings, trials, and multibillion-dollar settlements/penalties

stories.name: Meta AI cloud business
stories.blurb: Meta is reportedly building a cloud computing business to sell its excess AI compute capacity, positioning itself as a rival to AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

stories.name: Meta's AI data center buildout
stories.blurb: Meta is spending tens of billions of dollars building massive AI data centers across the U.S. and Canada, often through joint ventures like its partnership with BlackRock.

stories.name: Digital Ad Stock Watch
stories.blurb: Coverage of how Meta's social-media and ad-tech peers—Pinterest, Snap, Reddit, and AppLovin—are performing in the market amid shifts in advertising demand and user growth.

stories.name: AI Stock Rally
stories.blurb: A broad rally in AI-related stocks, including Meta, AMD, and semiconductor companies, is driving major market gains and record highs amid growing enthusiasm for artificial intelligence technology.

rel.why: Meta's Muse AI agent is driving the AI stock rally and AMD's $1T milestone, directly reflecting Meta's product success and market impact.

stories.name: Meta Power Deals
stories.blurb: Meta's contracts with energy companies like Vistra and Cogentrix to secure electricity for its data centers are fueling investor interest in power and nuclear-related stocks.

rel.why: General power/utility stock coverage (Vistra, Constellation, GE Vernova, Oklo) with no substantive link to Meta beyond a passing Cogentrix mention.

past.name: Meta's Muse AI Agent
past.blurb: Meta launched Muse, its first personal AI agent and coding assistant, as part of a broader push into AI to compete with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google while facing scrutiny over privacy and safety.

13.text: Meta launched the Meta Enterprise Platform, led by CJ Desai, bringing its Muse agent and APIs to corporate clients, and Zuckerberg joined Trump and other AI CEOs at the White House for a voluntary AI safety pact with independent audits. Meta also unveiled $1,299 VR glasses shipping spring 2027 and camera-less smart glasses, while reports credit its Ray-Ban partnership with leading the post-smartphone race.

8.text: Meta shares surged about 30–47% in a month, closing near $744–$778, beating the S&P 500 and Wall Street's price targets. Analysts debate whether AI-driven ad gains justify soaring capex and collapsing free cash flow, with views split between further upside and caution.

14.text: Meta launched its Muse personal AI agent and Charm device, expanded Muse to small businesses with payments and commerce tools, and saw its stock jump 13% in a week and roughly 30% in a month. No usage or revenue figures have been disclosed ahead of October earnings, and shares fell 8% as OpenAI prepares a challenge.

7.text: A New Mexico jury found Meta liable for nearly 44 million willful violations of the state's Unfair Practices Act over Cambridge Analytica-era misleading statements. Separately, Meta, Snap, TikTok, and YouTube reached a settlement with Brussels as 2,500-plus addiction lawsuits proceed.

9.text: Meta plans a C$13 billion AI data center in Alberta, where electricity supply is becoming central to hyperscaler spending. It is also preparing its first European bond issue to fund AI infrastructure.

10.text: AppLovin’s revenue growth is slowing, and it faces legal challenges while remaining highly profitable versus Reddit. The Trade Desk fell 18% over nine straight down days. Meta is not mentioned.

11.text: Meta's Muse AI agent sparked a multi-day rally in chip stocks, with AMD crossing a $1 trillion market cap and Intel jumping up to 17% on bets that agentic AI will drive much higher server CPU demand.

12.text: GE Vernova and Oklo are compared as industrial stocks, with GE Vernova noted for $38.1B revenue and Oklo still pre-revenue. Meta is barely mentioned; the story bears on Meta only as context for power deals.

5.text: Meta unveiled Muse, a personal AI agent that stays free for most users but takes small transaction fees, alongside a new connected device and expanded smart glasses and VR products. Retailers including Walmart, Sephora, and Best Buy signed on, and Meta's stock rose 27% as analysts framed Muse as a consumer growth strategy.
